content:
Maya Chen: Quick announcement — hiring wave + a small restructure in Eng Platform. Read on :loudspeaker:
Diego Ramos: Thanks Maya. High-level: we’re adding 10 IC roles + 2 leadership backfills, mostly across Serving Runtime and DevEx. This is to support Dedicated & Private demand. :rocket:
Maya Chen: Correct. Hiring plan attached: recruiting will prioritize roles that unblock Q2 Dedicated capacity and the Private on-prem beta. We’ll also convert one contractor role to FTE.
Lila (Recruiting): Hiring reqs are live in Greenhouse. I’ll ping the hiring owners in a bit. Referral bonuses still apply — please share widely. :moneybag:
Anya Patel: Hi all — I’m joining next week as Head of Eng Platform. Excited to get started and meet the teams. Planning a sync with Eng Platform on Monday. :wave:
Samir Desai: I’ll move from Sr Eng to interim Eng Platform Manager to cover day-to-day until Anya’s ramped. Will coordinate handoffs with runtime leads.
Kenji Tanaka: Quick Q — any changes to reporting for Serving Runtime leads?
Maya Chen: No lateral reporting changes today. We’ve only adjusted a couple of team boundaries: Storage & KV cache ops go under Platform infra; runtime kernel and model onboarding stay with Serving Runtime. Details in the doc link (HR&org doc): https://redwood.internal/docs/org/hiring-wave-2
Diego Ramos: We’ll run an all-hands town hall Thurs 11:00 PT for Q&A. Please bring questions about headcount, budgets, or hiring timelines.
Anya Patel: Looking forward to the town hall. My priorities: stabilize latency SLOs for Dedicated, speed up model onboarding, and improve dev experience for internal deploys.
Lila (Recruiting): Interview panels: we’ll need Eng + Product reviewers for some infra roles. I’ll follow up with suggested panel lists per role.
hr-bot: New job postings: 10 open roles added by Lila. See Greenhouse dashboard: https://greenhouse.example.com/org/redwood
Kenji Tanaka: Thanks — can we get visibility into ramp expectations (weeks to fill vs weeks to ramp)?
Maya Chen: Good point. Target is 8–12 weeks to hire for senior ICs, 12–16 to fully ramp. We’ll track in the hiring dashboard and share weekly.
Samir Desai: I’ll post the interim team assignments in #eng-platform after this thread.
Diego Ramos: Appreciate everyone moving quickly. This should give the platform teams breathing room for Dedicated and Private launches.
Maya Chen: If you have immediate follow-ups, DM me or Lila. Town hall invite is up. :calendar:
